# Neon AI Gateway

💳 Paid plan required / Plan payant requis. Curated by Skill Harbor — NOTE: despite its skill ID ("neon-postgres"), this skill is really about the **Neon AI Gateway**, not Postgres: one API and one Neon credential for frontier and open-source LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta and more), OpenAI-compatible, switching models by changing one field, with AI requests scoped to your Neon branch. Requires a paid Neon plan (the free plan refuses to provision it), and the gateway is currently available only in aws-us-east-2, aws-us-east-1, aws-eu-central-1, and aws-ap-southeast-1. Paid plans can also start with a reduced model catalog — check `/v1/models` for what's actually available on your branch. Works with the OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, google-genai, Vercel AI SDK, and Mastra by changing only the base URL. Companion to the general neon skill (listed separately). By @neondatabase, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
